banner.title: snapshot-controller
banner.tagline: Turns VolumeSnapshot objects into CSI snapshot calls, so kopiur can take Ceph block snapshots before it backs up a claim.

explainer.title: From a snapshot request to a Ceph image

steps.title: Request
steps.text: A VolumeSnapshot names a claim and a VolumeSnapshotClass. The kopiur Ceph SnapshotPolicy uses the csi-ceph-blockpool class.
steps.scene: a document card pinned to a glowing claim block

steps.title: Bind
steps.text: The controller binds the request to a VolumeSnapshotContent, and the class names the CSI driver and the pool.
steps.scene: two matching halves of a bracket joining

steps.title: Snapshot
steps.text: The Ceph CSI driver takes an RBD snapshot of the claim's image in the block pool. The controller records the handle.
steps.scene: a storage cylinder with a frozen layer

steps.title: Ready
steps.text: The snapshot reads ready once the driver confirms it, and the backup reads that point-in-time copy rather than the live claim.
steps.scene: a locked layer beneath a live block

art.title: How a snapshot reaches Ceph
